black.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents hatred and malice.
qualifications: Not an indicator of an actual person's intentions.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

brick_to_scarlet.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents anger,with distinct subtypes.
qualifications: The text distinguishes lurid red with brown clouds from vivid scarlet indignation;not every red is assigned this meaning.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

dragon_blood.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents sensual desire.
qualifications: Separate from the brick-red/scarlet anger family.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

brown.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents avarice.
qualifications: Clear brown is distinct from dull brown-grey.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

brown_grey.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents selfishness.
qualifications: A historical moral label,not a personal assessment.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

deep_grey.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents the historical motif called depression.
qualifications: Historical wording only;not clinical depression or a diagnostic criterion.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

pale_grey.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents fear.
qualifications: Distinct from deep heavy grey;not an observed emotional state.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

grey_green.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents deceit.
qualifications: Not interchangeable with clear green or sympathy.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

brown_green_scarlet.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents jealousy.
qualifications: Scarlet flecks are described as usual,not an independently mandatory test.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

green.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents adaptability.
qualifications: The source changes the motif with purity and mixtures:deceit,popularity-seeking or sympathy. Generic green does not resolve those variants.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

rose_family.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents affection.
qualifications: Broad family only;selfish/unselfish subtype requires a separately documented shade or mixture.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

carmine.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents ordinary affection.
qualifications: Clear carmine differs from carmine mixed with brown-grey.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

pale_rose.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents unselfish affection.
qualifications: No spiritual rank or personal capacity is inferred.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

crimson_brown_grey.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents selfish or grasping affection.
qualifications: A specifically documented mixture,not a general color blending algorithm.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

orange.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents pride or ambition.
qualifications: Neither a personality judgment nor a success prediction.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

yellow_family.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents intellect or intellectual gratification.
qualifications: No intelligence measurement or ability inference;subtypes depend on shade.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

yellow_ochre.motif: intellectual activity directed to selfish purposes
yellow_ochre.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents intellectual activity directed to selfish purposes.
qualifications: Historical ethical hierarchy retained as doctrine,not endorsed.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

gamboge.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents the source's stronger intellectual motif.
qualifications: No quantitative or individual intelligence assessment.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

primrose.motif: unselfish intellectual activity directed to spiritual ends
primrose.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents unselfish intellectual activity directed to spiritual ends.
qualifications: No mental ability or spiritual level is measured.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

blue.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents religious feeling.
qualifications: The text distinguishes brown-blue selfish devotion,grey-blue fear and clear devotional shades. Generic blue does not establish purity or spiritual status;frontispiece pure-blue key is narrower.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

violet.description: In Besant and Leadbeater's historical symbolic vocabulary,this color represents affection mixed with devotion.
qualifications: Delicate shades add an ideal-related qualification in the source;no universal chakra correspondence.
Manual symbolic selection only;not evidence about any person.

thought_form.description: A symbolic form in this historical doctrine;not an observed physical field.

mental_body.description: The source's hypothetical vehicle of intellectual activity;no anatomical location or layer number asserted.
mental_body.locator: The Difficulty of Representation,mental body discussion

desire_body.description: Also called astral body in this source;hypothetical vehicle of desires and feelings,not an anatomical structure.

figure-8.title: Vague Pure Affection
figure-8.description: A diffuse rosy cloud is described as gentle affection;the source distinguishes its vague outline from directed forms.
figure-8.locator: Illustrative Thought-Forms;Affection;Fig8 and named accompanying paragraph

figure-9.title: Vague Selfish Affection
figure-9.description: Carmine affection is mixed with dull brown-grey in the published illustration;the source calls the combination selfish affection.
figure-9.locator: Illustrative Thought-Forms;Affection;Fig9 and named accompanying paragraph

figure-12.title: Peace and Protection
figure-12.description: A wing-like rose form with a sunlit intellectual center represents a protective wish in the narrative;no actual protection or healing is established.
figure-12.locator: Illustrative Thought-Forms;Affection;Fig12 and named accompanying paragraph

figure-18.title: Vague Intellectual Pleasure
figure-18.description: A vague yellow cloud represents intellectual gratification in the narrative;the source distinguishes it from personal emotion.
figure-18.locator: Illustrative Thought-Forms;Intellect;Fig18 and named accompanying paragraph

conventions.edition: PG16269 title/reprint statement extends to1925;do not identify the transcription solely as a1901 or1905 edition.
conventions.locators: Section/figure locators authoritative;TOC page starts are not precise pagination for individual paragraphs. Transcriber reorders some plates.
conventions.key_coordinates: Original key rows top-to-bottom1-5,columns left-to-right1-5;legend is organized in columns. No calibrated RGB or brightness scale.
conventions.body_context: Context terminology is documentary only;not a color-to-layer assignment,seven-layer sequence or chakra system.
conventions.composition: A list of sourced motifs is compositional unless an explicit published example is selected;no novel combined meaning or outcome inferred.

source_cautions: The source claims clairvoyant observation and physical effects. Those assertions are historical claims,not scientific verification.
Historical ethical hierarchies and religious language are attributed,not applied to users.
Printed/scanned colors are imperfect reproductions per Foreword and Difficulty of Representation;no pixel-to-aura classifier is justified.
Ranked Brennan and Kunz systems remain separate and unsupported;this fallback does not implement their layer models.
